pitfalls: (1) INIT scope_freeze FAILed because correctness_fix mode auto-excludes the keyword Authority, which false-positived on the in-scope reference to authority-receipt callers — switched to mode=custom (no default keyword exclusions, empty excludedScope) since out-of-scope is fenced via execution_boundary allowedPaths/blockedPaths. (2) Evidence went stale 3x (after each implementer commit + after the main merge) because every source-changing commit drifts the materialHash — used verification_evidence_refresh_stale to rebind; metadata commits are material-excluded so they do not re-stale. (3) F-001 (found by behavior+quality reviewers): CHK-002 accidentally passed gitCwd to isMaterialExcludedPath, whose loadConfig needs metadataRoot — the exact gitCwd/metadataRoot confusion this story fights; fixed with a separate metadataRoot param. Next person: when threading gitCwd, audit every consumer for whether it needs the git cwd or the config/metadata root — they diverge only on wrapper-root, so plain-repo smokes will not catch it.
